body_lead: Siddharth Roy (siddharth001.roy@gmail.com) Artificial intelligence is no longer a futuristic concept confined to technology companies and research laboratories. Across the world, governments are increasingly using AI to improve public administration, reduce delays, enhance transparency, and deliver citizen-centric services. Assam’s recent push towards AI-led governance reflects an important recognition by Chief Secretary Ravi Kota and the state government that technology can become a powerful instrument for administrative transformation.
